long_biography.plain_text:
Oil entrepreneur Ecvet Sayer spent his school summers at drilling camps with his father, Oyman, a partner in Aladdin Middle East. The visits introduced him and his brother to field operations. Before concentrating on petroleum, Sayer worked in the automotive industry and later helped develop Aladdin's technical and administrative operations.

His exploration work included the Arpatepe discovery, where drilling reached productive sandstone instead of the limestone formations more familiar in Turkey. He also reopened wells that had been sealed with concrete when low oil prices made production uneconomic. Higher prices allowed the company to reconsider these previously abandoned sites.
